questions.question: Analyze the role of human activities in accelerating or hindering weathering. [8x3 = 24]
questions.solution_html:
• Air pollution (contributes to acid rain, which enhances chemical weathering of rocks and
  • buildings) - Deforestation ( removes protective vegetation, exposing rocks and soil to the
  • element) - Mining – quarrying – improper construction (disturb the land and making them
  • more vulnerable to weathering) - Agricultural practices ( such as over-irrigation and the use
  • of chemicals, can alter soil chemistry and promote weathering) - Urbanization (disturb surface
  • runoff and wate r infiltration in nearby rocks) - human-induced climate change - global
  • warming (intensifies weathering through more extreme temperature fluctuations and increased
  • rainfall and melting of snow - Collectively, these activities contribute to a faster breakdown
  • of the Earth’s surface materials. (8 marks) –any 8 points) . Increased rate of deforestation reduces
  • root wedging and chemical weathering and hinder weathering [CO2].
